entries.title: SUPERHOT

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best main archive route for the original non-VR game because it is the original full release platform, has the current Steam route, and is the cleanest high-quality capture target. SUPERHOT VR and MIND CONTROL DELETE are separate entries rather than replacement versions of the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Buy SUPERHOT on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build; play SUPERHOT VR and MIND CONTROL DELETE separately for those distinct games.

all_releases.fidelity: Original native PC release with current Steam availability.
all_releases.reason: primary: original full release route and best capture target.
skip: same core content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/settings target.
skip: console access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: console access route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.
skip: portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Cloud-streaming route, now discontinued with Stadia.
all_releases.reason: skip: discontinued cloud route and not suitable for current archive play.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented for the original non-VR game; VR and Mind Control Delete are separate games.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the original non-VR game with SUPERHOT VR or SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE; both are represented as separate entries.

entries.title: SUPERHOT VR
entries.definitive_edition: SUPERHOT VR on Windows PC VR via SteamVR

emulation.notes: Use a native SteamVR setup with a supported PCVR headset; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PCVR headset-dependent presentation with high-quality capture options.

primary.why: The Windows PC VR release is the best archive route because it pairs the rebuilt VR game with PCVR headset flexibility, higher-fidelity capture options, and SteamVR support. The Quest version is the most convenient untethered route and its store calls it definitive, but PCVR is the better streaming/archive target.
primary.how_to_play: Buy SUPERHOT VR on Steam, use a supported SteamVR headset from a Windows PC, and capture the PCVR output for the archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Original timed-exclusive Oculus Touch VR route.
all_releases.reason: skip: historical launch route, but current Windows PC VR via SteamVR is broader and easier to capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PCVR release with SteamVR headset support.
all_releases.reason: primary: best high-fidelity capture route for a VR archive run.
skip: console VR access route, but lower capture/control flexibility than Windows PC VR.

all_releases.fidelity: Standalone untethered VR route rebuilt for Quest.
all_releases.reason: skip: the Quest route is convenient and officially marketed as definitive, but PCVR remains the higher-fidelity capture target.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Meta Quest is the strongest untethered route and is marketed as definitive, but Windows PC VR is still the preferred archive choice for fidelity and capture control.

entries.remaster_caveats: SUPERHOT VR was rebuilt for VR and should not be treated as a simple VR mode for the flat game.

entries.title: SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE
entries.definitive_edition: SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because MIND CONTROL DELETE is explicitly a non-VR title with a full PC release, PC capture/settings flexibility, and the same complete content as the console versions. The Steam release also supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
primary.how_to_play: Buy SUPERHOT: MIND CONTROL DELETE on Steam for Windows PC and play the current non-VR native build.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete route with PC capture/settings flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Native desktop ports documented on Steam.
all_releases.reason: skip: same content family; Windows remains the preferred capture/settings target.
skip: console access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented between PC and console releases.

entries.remaster_caveats: MIND CONTROL DELETE is a non-VR standalone sequel/expansion entry, not a VR release.
